newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak on lack of interest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak on lack of interest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain weak on Friday on lack of investor interest before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget, but dealers said select blue chips could rise on speculative activity.
"Investors are in a wait-and-see mood ahead of the budget," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "The index is likely to slip below 1,500 points shortly as there is no institutional support."

On Thursday, the Karachi 100-share index fell 5.19 points, or 0.34 percent, to end at 1,507.98. Losers led gainers by 243 to 65. Turnover rose to 16.96 million shares from 14.71 million in the previous session.
